Safety First

Safe Place to Sell Gold Jewellery — In-Mall, Private, Documented

Selling gold involves carrying valuables in public and discussing real money at a counter. The safest place to sell gold jewellery is one designed for exactly that: a staffed in-mall store, a private and unhurried counter process, payment you can trace, and paperwork that proves the transaction. That is how our Gaur City Centre store is set up — this page explains the safety features you should demand anywhere.

📞 Call +91 99532 11815 💬 WhatsApp Us 📍 Get Directions

The Location: Inside Gaur City Centre

Safety starts before the counter. Samridhi Gold Buyers operates from Shop GF-04 inside Gaur City Centre at Gaur Chowk — a functioning commercial complex with security staff, CCTV-covered common areas, steady footfall and parking. Contrast the typical alternative: a small street-facing buying shop where you are the only customer, the shutters are half-down, and everyone on the road can see you walk in with a jewellery pouch. The mall setting also makes the visit ordinary — you can arrive with family, combine it with shopping, and leave unnoticed. Our store page has the exact location, floor and directions.

Privacy at the Counter

Your business stays your business. Items are tested and weighed on the counter in front of you — they never disappear into a back room, which protects both the jewellery and your peace of mind. Amounts are discussed discreetly, your documents are used only for the KYC the law requires, and your invoice is your private record of the sale. If at any point you want to pause, think, or consult family on the phone, the process waits — deciding later, or not at all, costs nothing because testing and valuation are free.

Payment Safety: Traceable Beats Risky

A safe sale ends with money you can prove you received. We pay by cash, NEFT or RTGS — your choice — against a proper invoice recording the items, purity, weight and amount. For significant sums we actively recommend bank transfer: it lands directly in your account while you watch, creates an automatic record, and removes the risk of carrying cash home. Read how the payment step works on our instant cash for gold page.

A Short Safety Checklist for Selling Anywhere

  • Choose a fixed, identifiable store — ideally in a staffed complex — over a pop-up or home-based buyer.
  • Never let your jewellery leave your sight for 'testing inside'.
  • Insist on an invoice; refuse no-paperwork deals however friendly they seem.
  • For large amounts, take bank transfer and wait the few minutes for it to be initiated in front of you.
  • Carry one photo ID yourself — a genuine buyer will always ask for it; one who doesn't is a warning sign.
How It Works

Sell in 4 Steps, 10–15 Minutes

1

Walk Into Our Store

Visit us at Shop No. GF-04, Gaur City Centre, Gaur Chowk, Sector 4, Greater Noida West with your jewellery and one valid photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport or Driving Licence).

2

Free XRF Testing

Your gold's purity is tested live on a German XRF Karatmeter. The result appears on screen in front of you — 100% transparent, zero damage.

3

Clear Valuation

We weigh your item in front of you and calculate the value from the live market rate and tested purity. Every number is explained — no hidden deductions.

4

Instant Payment

Accept the offer and get paid immediately by cash, NEFT or RTGS, with a proper invoice. The full process takes about 10–15 minutes.
